rows.en: I'll be serving as your bridge operator. Pleased to work with you.
I'm your bridge operator. Nice to meet you.
From today I'm your operator. Pleased to meet you.
I'll be your bridge operator. Let's work well together.
This is bridge operator Misa Hayase.
I'll relay mission details and battle status from now on.
I'll be briefing you on the mission and battle situation.
I'll give the orders, so just do as I say.
I'll relay mission info and battle status from now on.
You will follow my instructions.
Beginning the operation now.
Operation begins now.
Time to get to work!
Operation begins now.
Attention, pilots. Sortie at once. I repeat, sortie at once.
Operation start. All squadrons, go to combat stations.
Operation start. All squadrons, enter combat readiness.
The operation's starting!
Operation start. All squadrons, go to combat readiness.
Enemy closing fast! All units, combat readiness!
Oh, it's been a while. I look forward to working with you again.
Oh, so it's you. I'll be looking after you again.
Who the hell are you? Pretty chummy, aren't you? Kidding. You remember me, right?
Operating for you again, huh. I'm counting on you.
It's been a while. I'll be giving you your orders.
We have arrived at the operation area.

Likely enemy leader unit located.

Unknown aircraft spotted. It's closing on us fast.
Hey, a tough-looking enemy just showed up.
Unknown aircraft! It's coming right at us, really fast!
Unknown aircraft detected. It's heading for us at tremendous speed.
Unidentified aircraft detected. It's heading this way.

rows.en: Unidentified aircraft detected. It's heading our way.
Unidentified contact detected, and it's coming this way!

You're taking too many hits!
Damage is mounting.
Damage rising.
Keep your damage down, you hack!

Can you complete the mission like this?
